description: This file contains utility functions for persisting and restoring SQL Lab state, including query results, query editors, and table metadata, in a Redux-based application for Apache Superset.

methods.name: shouldEmptyQueryResults
methods.description: Determines if a query's results should be cleared based on age or size constraints.

methods.name: emptyTablePersistData
methods.description: Extracts and filters table metadata for persistence.

methods.name: emptyQueryResults
methods.description: Resets query results to empty if they exceed age or size limits.

methods.name: clearQueryEditors
methods.description: Resets query editor state, keeping only persistent keys.

methods.name: rehydratePersistedState
methods.description: Restores persisted table metadata into the application state via dispatch.
